stories.dek: DeVonta Smith's 45.0 puts Lawrence of a Labia up 31.20 on the best team in the league, Javonte Williams flips the first-place game, and Black Friday decides a few more.
body: Four games are in the books and the Week 12 board looks nothing like the lines. Achane in the Membrane leads Stroud of Turin 86.50 to 23.50 after Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 205 yards and three touchdowns in Detroit's 39-35 loss to Chicago (49.2 points) on top of Blake Corum's 28.5 from Wednesday night. Stroud of Turin was a 1.5-point favorite. Amon-Ra St. Brown did his part with 146 yards and 21.6, but Dallas Goedert caught one ball for 1.9 and is now listed Out with a shoulder injury, and RedDevil904 has seven starters left to make up 63.00 points.

In the first-place game, Ivefallenandicantgetup leads NjigbaR Please! 59.64 to 27.60. Josh Allen scored 3.54 in a 13-10 rain game against Kansas City and it didn't matter, because Javonte Williams scored three touchdowns in Dallas for 33.3 and James Cook III ran for 117 yards and a score (19.5). Travis Kelce added 11.1 for NjigbaR Please!, which still has seven starters left, including Ashton Jeanty, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Tetairoa McMillan (both questionable). Ivefallenandicantgetup has five left, Derrick Henry among them.

And then there's me. Lawrence of a Labia leads Lead Nagger 62.50 to 31.30 because DeVonta Smith caught 11 passes for 200 yards and two long touchdowns from Joe Milton in the Eagles' 39-38 win at Dallas: 45.0 points, the second-best score of the week behind Gibbs. I was a 14.5-point underdog. I also left Kyle Monangai (two touchdowns, 15.9) and Konata Mumpfield (10.9) on my bench while DJ Moore scored 3.5 in the rain, so Bill_Buttlicker has 26.80 points on the pine before Sunday. Lead Nagger has seven starters to go, including Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins, Emeka Egbuka and Jonah Coleman, who plays today in Pittsburgh.

Elsewhere: Wild Goose Chase leads MY DAD IS DEAD 78.12 to 56.68 (D'Andre Swift 29.2, CeeDee Lamb 20.4) despite Rome Odunze's game-winning catch (27.7) and Dak Prescott's 25.54; Saquon Barkley left with a stinger in the first quarter after 0.7. Nothing to see here leads Bijan is your daddy 42.40 to 14.40 behind Caleb Williams' 345 yards (26.3) and Makai Lemon's 16.1. Llamageddon leads Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 15.82 to 10.60 after Jared Goff's 15.82 and Colston Loveland's -0.5. Denver at Pittsburgh this afternoon brings DK Metcalf, Jaylen Waddle, Jaylen Warren, Jonah Coleman and both defenses, with Mason Rudolph starting at quarterback for the Steelers.

stories.title: Playoff Race: Thanksgiving moves Lawrence of a Labia up to the 2 seed and Wild Goose Chase to 85%
stories.dek: Leads aren't wins yet, but if Thursday's scores hold: three 8-3 teams become 9-3, two byes go to the team that was down 16.50 and the team that was a 14.5-point dog, and the 6-5 logjam thins out.
body: The simulator ran 20,000 seasons this morning, counting each Week 12 game for whoever leads after Thanksgiving and playing Weeks 13 and 14 off the real schedule with each team's season scoring average. Projected seeds: 1 Ivefallenandicantgetup (10.4 projected wins, 100%), 2 Lawrence of a Labia (9.9, 100%), 3 NjigbaR Please! (9.2, 100%), 4 Lead Nagger (8.3, 99%), 5 Wild Goose Chase (8.0, 85%), 6 Stroud of Turin (7.2, 66%).

First three out: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (6.9, 20%), Llamageddon (6.8, 16%) and Achane in the Membrane (6.1, 15%). Bijan is your daddy, down 42.40 to 14.40 with eight starters to play, drops to 0% in this version because it's counted as a loss; it's 5-6 and a Sunday comeback puts it back in the conversation. Nothing to see here and MY DAD IS DEAD are out.

The big swings are all Thanksgiving. Stroud of Turin trails Achane in the Membrane by 63.00, and if that holds, RedDevil904 goes from the 5 seed to the 6 at 66%, and it would be one of three 6-6 teams with Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and Llamageddon; Stroud of Turin has the most points of the three. Lawrence of a Labia leading Lead Nagger by 31.20 is the difference between a bye and a wild-card game for both teams. Ivefallenandicantgetup leading NjigbaR Please! by 32.04 moves the 1 seed.

The bracket from those seeds: Lead Nagger over Wild Goose Chase (59%) and Stroud of Turin over NjigbaR Please! (55%) in the wild-card round, then Lead Nagger over Ivefallenandicantgetup (66%) and Stroud of Turin over Lawrence of a Labia (60%), and Lead Nagger over Stroud of Turin (57%) in the final. Title odds: Lead Nagger 24%, Lawrence of a Labia 18%, Stroud of Turin 17%, Ivefallenandicantgetup 17%, Wild Goose Chase 12%, NjigbaR Please! 11%. Higher scoring average wins every game in the projection, which is why the two best-scoring teams keep meeting in the final no matter where they're seeded.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane loses by six hundredths, Bijan is your daddy comes back from 38 down on Monday night, and Llamageddon's 58.52 makes the Hall of Fame
stories.dek: Three Commanders erase a 38.18-point deficit, Mike Gesicki falls 0.06 short, Ja'Marr Chase falls 9.95 short, and there are now three 8-3 teams.
body: Monday night decided three games and made two people sick. Bijan is your daddy went into Monday down 101.26 to 63.08 to Ivefallenandicantgetup, and Jayden Daniels (17.06), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (15.7, a touchdown in his first game off IR) and Stefon Diggs (8.5) scored 41.26 to win 104.34 to 101.26. krunkdd had nobody left to play, Derrick Henry (19.1) and Justice Hill (17.6) on the bench, and a best possible lineup of 112.46 that wins. The Tampa Bay defense, a $12 claim, scored 0.0.

Achane in the Membrane went into Monday down 4.16 to Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, with Mike Gesicki against Chase Brown. Gesicki caught 5 passes for 77 yards, 12.7 points. Chase Brown scored 8.6. Final: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 128.22, Achane in the Membrane 128.16. Six hundredths. Devaughn Vele scored 14.6 on MakeItRains's bench while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 5.0, and the best possible lineup was 137.86. It's the fourth-highest score of the week and Achane in the Membrane is 4-7 with a 68-53 all-play record.

Stroud of Turin needed 18.05 from Ja'Marr Chase and got 8.1, so NjigbaR Please! won 116.50 to 106.56 behind Ashton Jeanty (28.9) and Travis Kelce (25.4). Lead Nagger beat Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52, a 79.28-point margin and the biggest of the week. Llamageddon's 58.52 is the lowest score in the league this season and the fifth-lowest in league history, which bumps RedDevil904's 58.64 out of the Hall of Fame's basement. Lawrence of a Labia scored 143.22, the high of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD (124.70, with Dak Prescott at 35.9) by 18.52, with Fernando Mendoza's 23.88 on my own bench behind Trevor Lawrence's 12.74. Wild Goose Chase beat Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 while Antonio Williams scored 21.2 on ChuckJ10's bench.

Where that leaves us: NjigbaR Please!, Ivefallenandicantgetup and Lawrence of a Labia are all 8-3, Lead Nagger is 7-4, and Stroud of Turin, Wild Goose Chase and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered are 6-5 fighting over two spots. Three weeks left. MakeItRains won the Week 11 defense payout with the Chicago Bears (17.0), which is the most expensive consolation prize in league history.

columns.title: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner: STROUD OF TURIN IS DOWN SIXTY-THREE and RedDevil904 is going to tell you about the Aaron Rodgers drop
columns.dek: Yes, the Rodgers call was right. No, it does not cover a 63-point hole. I will be yelling about this until Monday night.
body: I ate Thanksgiving dinner in the press box. Paper plate. Turkey from the vending machine, and I don't want to talk about how a vending machine has turkey. And while I'm eating it, I watch Jahmyr Gibbs run for TWO HUNDRED AND FIVE YARDS and three touchdowns, and I look up at the board, and Achane in the Membrane is up 86.50 to 23.50 on Stroud of Turin. SIXTY-THREE POINTS. On a Thursday.

Now, RedDevil904 is going to come at me with the Rodgers thing, and FINE, I'll give it to him. Wednesday morning at 8:18 he dropped Aaron Rodgers for Sam Darnold. That same week the Steelers benched Rodgers and moved on, and Mason Rudolph starts today against Denver. That's a good call! That's a GREAT call! You know what it's worth this week? ZERO POINTS, because neither quarterback was ever starting over C.J. Stroud.

Here is what IS worth points. Stroud of Turin scores 127.68 a week, second-best in the league, 72-49 in all-play, and it was a 1.5-point FAVORITE in this game. Amon-Ra St. Brown went for 146 yards and 21.6. Great. Dallas Goedert caught ONE PASS for 1.9 and now he's listed Out with a shoulder. You've got seven starters left, C.J. Stroud, Ja'Marr Chase, Chuba Hubbard, all of them, and they need to outscore Achane in the Membrane's five remaining guys by 63 POINTS. That's not a comeback. That's a MIRACLE with a waiver bid.

I'm HEARING things, and they are not good. Word in the press box is RedDevil904 is trying to get the league to count Wednesday's Rodgers drop as "points saved" and add them to his Week 12 total. I'm told he's got a spreadsheet. I'm told the spreadsheet has a tab called "MORAL VICTORIES." None of this is confirmed, and the guy who told me also said the vending machine turkey was fresh, which it WAS NOT.

Here's where I land. If this holds, Stroud of Turin is 6-6, the simulator drops it to the 6 seed at 66%, and it's in a three-way pile at 6-6 with Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and Llamageddon. It has the most points of the three, so it's still the favorite for that spot. But the line was 1.5 and the deficit is 63, and I need EVERYBODY to understand that the smartest move of the week happened on the team that is getting its DOORS BLOWN OFF. That's fantasy football. THAT'S THE WHOLE SPORT.

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: Blake Corum ran 32 times and Stroud of Turin is down 33 before the turkey. Soft.
columns.dek: Thirty-two carries is a man's workload. Watching Achane in the Membrane get it on the waiver-wire side of the room is the soft part.
body: Put the tape on. Rams-Packers, Wednesday night. The Rams ran it 47 times. Blake Corum took 32 of them for 184 yards and a touchdown, 25 carries for 161 in the second half alone. That's not a running back, that's a man pushing a sled up a hill for three hours. He caught two more for 21. That's 28.5 points in the Achane in the Membrane lineup, and that's a 33.40-to-0.00 lead on Stroud of Turin before anybody's carved a bird.

Now the soft part. Stroud of Turin was a 1.5-point favorite in this game. RedDevil904 spent Wednesday morning cutting Aaron Rodgers to pick up Sam Darnold, a backup quarterback move on a team starting C.J. Stroud. That's housekeeping. Meanwhile the other guy's running back was getting fitted for an ice bath. You want to win a fantasy matchup, you go get the guy who gets the ball 32 times. Simple.

And Green Bay. Christian Watson caught four for 65 and a touchdown, 16.5 for Wild Goose Chase, then took a shot from Kam Kinchens before halftime and was out with a concussion. Kinchens got tossed. After that the Packers ran 16 plays in the second half. Jordan Love threw two picks for 8.62. That's a quarterback getting bullied. Br0phy still leads MY DAD IS DEAD 28.52 to nothing because MY DAD IS DEAD hasn't played, not because anybody in green was tough.

I'm HEARING things from the film room, and I want to be clear none of this is confirmed. Word is MakeItRains watched Corum's second half standing up, in pads, in his living room, and tried to set his Week 13 lineup by yelling it at the TV. Sources say he's now proposing a league rule that any running back with 30 carries counts double. None of this is confirmed. All of it should be.

Bottom line. Achane in the Membrane is 4-7 and still a long shot at 9%. But that's a team that went out and got hit in the mouth by six hundredths last week and came back and ran the ball 32 times. Stroud of Turin, you've got Amon-Ra St. Brown and Dallas Goedert today. Hit somebody.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's six Black Friday moves that are guaranteed to win your Week 12
columns.dek: Denver at Pittsburgh this afternoon, Mason Rudolph at quarterback, and Oliver has a plan for all of it.
body: I'm writing this from the lawn chair in the Target parking lot, where I've been since 4 AM, not to buy anything, just to be near the energy. Denver plays at Pittsburgh at 3 PM and six league starters are in it: DK Metcalf and the Denver defense for Llamageddon, Jaylen Waddle and Jaylen Warren for Achane in the Membrane, Jonah Coleman for Lead Nagger, and the Pittsburgh defense for Nothing to see here. Here's how to handle it.

1. Start both defenses in the same game. If the Broncos defense scores and the Steelers defense scores, you scored twice. dcrabb has Denver's and ChuckJ10 has Pittsburgh's, and they're not even playing each other, so they should trade defenses and then trade back, which counts as two moves and therefore two times the points.

2. Start any quarterback who wasn't the starter on Monday. Mason Rudolph wasn't the Steelers' starter on Monday and he is today. Sam Darnold wasn't on RedDevil904's roster on Tuesday and he is now. That's momentum. Momentum is a stat. 3. Bench anyone who scored on Thanksgiving. They already used up their points. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 49.2; that's at least three weeks of points. MakeItRains should bench him through the playoffs.

4. If you're down by 63, like Stroud of Turin, drop everyone who has already played and pick up players who haven't. That way your team has more unplayed points. Amon-Ra St. Brown has 21.6 and that number can only go down from here (it can't). 5. If you're up by 31, like Lawrence of a Labia, unplug the TV. Points that aren't watched don't count. That's the rule. I've been doing it for years, and my record is private.

6. I'm HEARING that krunkdd plans to wear Josh Allen's 3.54 as a jersey number on Sunday so the Bills quarterback "feels the pressure to bounce back." Word is the jersey has a decimal point sewn on and the decimal point keeps falling off. I'm told the Ivefallenandicantgetup lead (59.64 to 27.60) is entirely because of the jersey. None of this is confirmed, and I heard it from a man in the next lawn chair who was asleep.

Bottom line: the real numbers are Ivefallenandicantgetup up 32.04, Achane in the Membrane up 63.00, Lawrence of a Labia up 31.20, and six starters playing this afternoon. My numbers are better, but nobody listens to me, which is why I'm in a parking lot.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: Lawrence of a Labia scored 20.83 points per Thanksgiving starter, which means Lead Nagger is mathematically finished
columns.dek: I divided the holiday scores by the number of players who played. The results are conclusive, and also not how math works.
body: Let's start with the numbers, because the numbers are real. Lawrence of a Labia has 62.50 points from three starters who have played: DeVonta Smith 45.0, Jameson Williams 14.0 and DJ Moore 3.5. That's 20.83 points per starter. Lead Nagger has 31.30 from two: Emmett Johnson 19.6 and George Pickens 11.7. That's 15.65 per starter.

Now the analytics. Lead Nagger has seven starters left. At 15.65 apiece that's 109.55 more, for a projected 140.85. Lawrence of a Labia has six left; at 20.83 apiece that's 125.0 more, for a projected 187.50. My model gives Lawrence of a Labia a 46.65-point win and a 187.50 that would miss the league's all-time top five by 6.64. I'd like to point out I did not consult George Kittle or Christian McCaffrey before publishing this.

Same method, everywhere else. Achane in the Membrane: 86.50 from four starters, 21.63 per starter, five left, projected 194.63, which would sneak into the league's all-time top five. Ivefallenandicantgetup: 59.64 from four, 14.91 per, five left, projected 134.19. NjigbaR Please!: 27.60 from two, 13.80 per, seven left, projected 124.20. So NjigbaR Please! loses by 9.99, which is close enough to 10 that I'm calling it a round number and a sign.

Sources say, and I want to stress that these sources are a calculator I found in a parking lot, that Pudge247 has already asked the commish to replace per-game scoring with per-starter scoring for the rest of the year, but only for teams that are 7-4. I'm told he has a slide deck. I'm told the slide deck has one slide and it says "PER CAPITA." None of this is confirmed.

The real takeaway, which my method accidentally gets right: Lead Nagger scores 133.59 a week, the most in the league, and has seven starters to play. A 31.20-point hole is less than a quarter of one normal Lead Nagger week. Lawrence of a Labia was a 14.5-point underdog for a reason. My model says it's over. My model also thinks DJ Moore is worth 20.83 points, and he scored 3.5.

items.title: NjigbaR Please! vs. Ivefallenandicantgetup: two 8-3 teams play for the 1 seed
items.dek: First place, the projected 1 and 2 seeds, and two banged-up running backs.
body: On paper this is the game of the week. NjigbaR Please! and Ivefallenandicantgetup are both 8-3, first and second on the projected seed list, and the winner leads the league with two weeks left. NjigbaR Please! scores 123.28 a week with a 73-48 all-play record; Ivefallenandicantgetup scores 119.38 with a 64-57 all-play record. One team has been good; the other has been good at Sundays.

The gap is 3.90, so the line is NjigbaR Please! by 3.5, a 54% favorite, with a 242.7 total. No nudge: there are no byes, Kyren Williams is a full participant on the Rams' report, and Derrick Henry cleared his concussion evaluation, with Justice Hill behind him on the same roster.

Thanksgiving flipped it. Ivefallenandicantgetup leads 59.64 to 27.60: Josh Allen scored 3.54 in the Buffalo rain, but Javonte Williams scored three touchdowns in Dallas for 33.3 and James Cook III ran for 117 yards and a score (19.5). Travis Kelce's 11.1 is all NjigbaR Please! got Thursday on top of Kyren Williams' 16.5. NjigbaR Please! needs 32.05 more than Ivefallenandicantgetup from here with seven starters against five, Derrick Henry included. At 123.28 a week, seven starters should produce plenty, but this pick is in trouble.

Through Thanksgiving it's Nothing to see here 42.40, Bijan is your daddy 14.40. Caleb Williams threw for 345 yards and the game-winner (26.3) and Makai Lemon scored 16.1; Sam LaPorta's 14.4 is the only Bijan is your daddy score, with Khalil Shakir's 6.3 on the bench. Bijan is your daddy has eight starters left, including Bijan Robinson, Jayden Daniels and Trey McBride, to Nothing to see here's seven. A 36.5-point swing is needed to cover. Very doable for eight starters; very FatMikeR to need it.

items.dek: The projected 5 seed gets its Packers back from the bye against a 1-10 team.
body: The biggest spread of Week 12. Wild Goose Chase is 6-5, scores 125.79 a week, is 67-54 in all-play and is the projected 6 seed at 69% this morning. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-10, scores 102.31 a week and has lost nine straight, though it did score 124.70 last week.

The gap is 23.48, so the line is Wild Goose Chase by 23.5, a 78% favorite, with a 228.1 total. No nudge. Br0phy gets Jordan Love, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft back from the bye, and Drake Maye (ankle) is still out. Saquon Barkley is a full participant on Philadelphia's report ahead of Thanksgiving for MY DAD IS DEAD.

Wild Goose Chase leads 78.12 to 56.68 after Thanksgiving, a 21.44-point margin, two short of the line. D'Andre Swift scored 29.2 and CeeDee Lamb 20.4 on top of Wednesday's 28.52, but MY DAD IS DEAD answered with Rome Odunze's game-winning 27.7 and Dak Prescott's 25.54, and lost Saquon Barkley to a stinger after 0.7. Wild Goose Chase has four starters left (Aaron Jones Sr., Nico Collins, Dylan Sampson, Jets defense) to five for MY DAD IS DEAD (Travis Etienne Jr., Chris Olave, T.J. Hockenson, Ladd McConkey, Giants defense). The win is likely; the cover is a coin flip.
